description: You are a Junior Economist. Navigate to the St. Louis Fed's FRED database (fred.stlouisfed.org). Create a custom graph that compares two data series on the SAME chart: the 'Unemployment Rate' (UNRATE) and the 'Labor Force Participation Rate' (CIVPART). Adjust the date range to show data from 2019-01-01 to the present. Once configured, download the graph image as a PNG to '~/Documents/labor_market_chart.png' and download the underlying data as a CSV file to '~/Documents/labor_market_data.csv'. Finally, bookmark your custom graph page with the title 'Labor Market Dashboard'.
